name: claim-card
title: Claim Card
description: One claim, examined. The card quotes a claim as a reader heard it, gives a short answer, and keeps the evidence one click away in collapsible sections: the facts and their sources, who makes the claim, where the record is contested, what the answer does…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/claim-card

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/claim-card.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/claim-card';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/claim-card

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
